messages:
ada: Heads up — invoices for the last hourly bucket show weird 'claim penumbra' spikes. Small tenants getting double-counted around top-of-hour. cc @mario @sasha
mario: I see it on the console preview (https://console.redwood.internal/preview/penumbra). Numbers spike in the final 10s of the window.
sasha: Is this the 'late-arrival zone' we talked about in last retro? :thinking:
kai: Yep. Root cause seems to be ingest watermark vs aggregator cutover. Events arriving just after the watermark but with older event_ts get folded into previous bucket when the join runs.
ada: Quick numbers: sample query shows ~1.2k tokens in the penumbra across 47 tenants for the 1h window ending 15:00 UTC.
mario: Options:
- A) make claim window configurable per-route (default small ms)
- B) add de-dup/attribution pass after join
- C) surface 'unstable' badge in invoice preview and warn users
sasha: Product would accept A + C. De-duping may be risky for runtime.
kai: Implementation plan:
1) add metering API field `claimWindowMs` (int, ms)
2) default=1000ms, allow per-route override
3) rollout via canary to 5% tenants for 2h
4) emit metric `metering.penumbra_rate` and dashboard card
ops: add alert: penumbra_rate > 0.5% tokens over 5m -> ops channel. Page if >2% over 15m.
mario: config example:
```
metering:
  claim_window_ms: 500
  penumbra_sampling: true
```
sasha: For UX: invoice preview should show a tiny tooltip "Events in the final window may reassign for up to Xs — amounts are preliminary". Also add link to runbook.
kai: Agree. Also we should not retroactively rewrite invoices by default. Maybe have a 'reconciliation job' flagged for revenue ops if ratios are high.
ops: I'll stand up the canary and dashboard today. @billing-bot can you emit sample events against the canary tenant?
billing-bot: Canary metering run started for tenant sample-42 at 2024-11-12T15:03Z :white_check_mark:
ada: PR incoming with metering API + small console badge change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/12345
mario: Nice. After canary, let's evaluate penumbra_rate and decide on default value. :eyes:
sasha: One last ask — add a console card showing 'penumbra token count' per tenant so support can triage customer complaints quickly.
ops: noted. creating dashboard ticket in #eng-sre.
ada: thx all, will follow up with rollout timeline and retro notes.
